description: List the top 10 films by share of inventory copies, returning exactly 10 rows and choosing arbitrarily among films tied at the cut.

b.request: List the top 10 `film_id`s by count of rows in `inventory` (copies per film divided by total inventory rows, unrounded, as `share`), ordered by share descending, returning exactly 10 rows with ties at the cutoff broken arbitrarily
b.sql: SELECT film_id, COUNT(*) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM inventory) AS share FROM inventory GROUP BY film_id ORDER BY share DESC LIMIT 10

c.request: What are the top 10 films by number of copies in our inventory? For each, show the `film_id`, how many copies we have, and what share of all inventory copies that is (copies divided by the total number of copies, unrounded), with the highest share first. List the top 10 films by share of inventory copies, returning exactly 10 rows and choosing arbitrarily among films tied at the cut.
c.sql: SELECT film_id, COUNT(*) AS copies, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM inventory) AS share FROM inventory GROUP BY film_id ORDER BY share DESC LIMIT 10

a.request: For each film in the inventory, show its `film_id`, its number of copies (inventory records), and its share of all inventory copies (its copy count divided by the total number of copies across all films, unrounded). Sort from highest share to lowest and return exactly the top 10 films; if several films tie at the cutoff, any of them can fill the remaining spots.
a.sql: SELECT film_id, COUNT(*) AS copies, CAST(COUNT(*) AS DOUBLE) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM inventory) AS share FROM inventory GROUP BY film_id ORDER BY share DESC, film_id LIMIT 10

d.request: List the 10 films with the highest share of total inventory copies (each film's copies divided by the total number of copies, unrounded), showing `film_id`, copy count, and share, sorted by share descending. Return exactly 10 rows, breaking ties at the 10th position arbitrarily.
d.sql: SELECT t.film_id, t.copies, CAST(t.copies AS DOUBLE) / tot.total AS share FROM (SELECT film_id, COUNT(*) AS copies FROM inventory GROUP BY film_id) AS t CROSS JOIN (SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM inventory) AS tot ORDER BY share DESC LIMIT 10
